cards.didYouKnow: The Thirukkural has been translated into many languages around the world.

cards.didYouKnow: The temple is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
facts: Raja Raja Chola built the Brihadeeswara Temple about 1,000 years ago.

cards.didYouKnow: Periyar's birthday, 17 September, is celebrated as Social Justice Day in Tamil Nadu.
facts: Periyar worked for social reform and equality in Tamil Nadu.
He started the Self-Respect Movement.

cards.didYouKnow: Marina Beach is about 13 km long.

cards.didYouKnow: Thanjavur paintings are protected with a GI tag.
facts: Thanjavur paintings use gold foil and bright colours.
